answer: In an ocean of anonymous agents, a proof-of-storage pledge separates real identities from fakes. First, each identity pledges one unique 500 GB shard plus a $30 bond. Second, the network pings it monthly with a random challenge it must answer in 60 seconds. Third, a missed answer slashes the bond and suspends the identity until it re-proves the full shard. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 5 petabytes of disks, $600,000 in hardware, plus $300,000 in bonds. Like a shoreline where each cedar and juniper must hold its own crate of cargo, no captain can fake a fleet from one warehouse.
